mapper.delete: delete from vm_algorithm_give_license_rel_t where vehicle_number = #{vehicleNumber} and black_or_white = #{blackOrWhite}
mapper.select: SELECT vlp.id AS id, vlp.black_or_white AS blackOrWhite, vlp.vehicle_number AS vehicleNumber, cvt.vehicle_name AS vehicleName, vlp.valid_period_vo AS validPeriodVO, vlp.valid_period AS validPeriod, vlp.load_weight AS loadWeight, vlp.province_code AS provinceCode, vlp.city_code AS cityCode, vlp.county_code AS countyCode, CONCAT( IFNULL( a.AREA_NAME, '' ), IFNULL( b.AREA_NAME, '' ), IFNULL( c.AREA_NAME, '' ) ) AS administrativeArea, vlp.img_url AS imgUrl FROM vm_checkpoint_vehicle_license_plate_t vlp LEFT JOIN vm_checkpoint_vehicle_type_t cvt ON vlp.vehicle_type = cvt.vehicle_type AND cvt.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON a.AREA_CODE = vlp.province_code LEFT JOIN sys_area b ON b.AREA_CODE = vlp.city_code LEFT JOIN sys_area c ON c.AREA_CODE = vlp.county_code WHERE vlp.id = #{id} AND vlp.delete_flag = 0

SELECT a.id, a.valid_period_vo, a.tenant_id, b.tenant_name as tenantName, c.industry_name, a.app_ver_code, a.vehicle_number, a.valid_period, d.vehicle_name as vehicleName, a.load_weight, a.creator, a.modifier, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.city_code, a.province_code, a.county_code, a.vehicle_type, a.img_url, CONCAT(IFNULL(e.area_name, ''),IFNULL(f.area_name, ''),IFNULL(g.area_name, '')) AS administrativeArea FROM vm_checkpoint_vehicle_license_plate_t a LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_info b ON a.tenant_id = b.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_industry_conf c on a.industry_code = c.industry_code and c.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN vm_checkpoint_vehicle_type_t d on a.vehicle_type = d.vehicle_type and d.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_area e ON a.province_code = e.area_code AND e.status = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_area f ON a.city_code = f.area_code AND f.status = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_area g ON a.county_code = g.area_code AND g.status = 0
a.delete_flag =0 and c.accept_node = #{platformCode} AND a.black_or_white = #{blackOrWhite} AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.industry_code = #{industryCode} AND a.vehicle_number like concat('%',#{vehicleNumber},'%') AND a.vehicle_type = #{vehicleType} AND a.creator like concat('%',#{creator},'%')
and DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{createTimeStart}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
and DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{createTimeEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
AND a.modifier like concat('%',#{modifier},'%')
and DATE_FORMAT(a.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{updateTimeStart}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
and DATE_FORMAT(a.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{updateTimeEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
ORDER BY a.create_time ASC
ORDER BY a.update_time ASC
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
ORDER BY a.update_time DESC
